notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: Just a heads up to everyone that I've released a small update that fixes a few bugs, including one potentially game-stopping one that was reported.  The update should be nearly instantaneous!  My apologies to anyone affected by these issues.  I will continue to update the game as needed if additional bugs are reported.
